items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: One of his latest recordings is with Arbors artist Rebecca Kilgore, entitled “I Saw Stars.”

ctx.x: Well it’s there. You think you’ll have to go out and buy it?

They got it here. No I do have that, and I love the way Rebecca sounds on there, I just think it’s great. Well thank you for playing that. It’s always nice to hear myself play something that I like. And it was nicely recorded. A lot of times, a big problem with the bass is the recorded sound. A lot of times it’s tough.
They just don’t know how you think?

items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Oh, that’s Becky Kilgore. Yeah, I recognized me, in fact, is that on the record?

ctx.x: He has some groups. And Becky Kilgore and Dave have recorded together so they have material to work from. And then you have somebody like Dave McKenna, which is like a whole orchestra by himself. And so Joe knows how to do it and he knows how to mix guys — like Cal and I doing a duo together, and we have played together over the years. And he knows, to a degree, what’s going to work. And it’s just again, there’s not many groups around anymore, except a few very famous ones.
I wanted to play something for you, and see if you recognize this.
